deck.name: Academic Collocations 17/83
deck.description: 2,468 distinct academic collocations from Pearson's Academic Collocation List (PTE v2/2025). Source: Pearson International Corpus of Academic English. (The source numbers entries up to 2,469 but skips one in the 'significant' group.)
deck.subtitle: PTE · 30 collocations · 17/83

examples.en: Curiosity is a defining characteristic of good scientists.

examples.en: Flexibility became the defining characteristic of the new design.

cards.vietnamese: phát triển một cách tiếp cận

examples.en: The school tried to develop an approach suited to young learners.

examples.en: Therapists develop an approach tailored to each patient.

examples.en: A good essay should develop an argument step by step.
